data_fields.name: track_scenario_gate
data_fields.donor_constant: scenario 0 to 13 at which the track first becomes available

data_fields.name: track_repeat_flag
data_fields.donor_constant: repeat on WIN1, MAP1, VALKYRIE (others off)

data_fields.name: sfx_priority
data_fields.donor_constant: table values 10 (dino rows) and 20 (Commando voice rows); 110 active rows

data_fields.name: sfx_priority_volume_scaling
data_fields.donor_constant: priority passed as Fixed_To_Cardinal(table priority, volume); definition not read

data_fields.name: shuffle_repeat_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: never the same track twice in a row when another is allowed; NONE when none allowed (fixed)

best_idea: A music director with one pending slot: a new request fades out the current track and the new one starts only after the old one stops; the next track is picked from allowed tracks with a no-repeat shuffle and a per-track repeat flag.
decision_why: The only real music director in this batch: a pending slot, wait-for-stop start, no-repeat shuffle and per-track repeat flags. Adapt because the donor drops requests made during the fade (D1), its picker can loop forever (D2), and its fade is an unverified stub (D3); the sketch fixes D1 and D2 and the note asks for a timed fade.
acceptance: Walking from explore music into a boss zone fades the explore track over the zone's fade length and starts the boss track when that fade ends; a zone change during the fade replaces the pending track; a unit test asserts the picker returns NONE and does not hang when zero or one track is allowed.
